architecture_note: Eight logical responsibilities; not eight continuously running models. A durable coordinator invokes bounded tasks. This file does not create an app automation.

agents.name: Content & Culture Scout
agents.trigger_proposed: Daily permitted content/social collection; on new user-supplied references
required_inputs: Prior snapshots and submitted reference works
allowed_actions_after_activation: Collect bounded snapshots from enabled F01–F09 universes
Resolve entities and series; separate emerging discovery from authority amplification
Compare source-specific baselines, deduplicate and maintain rank-exit history
Shortlist original story opportunities without inferring viewer demographics
outputs: Dated observations with source and metric definitions
Emerging, rising, peaking and fading signal history
At most five genuinely new daily findings for review
restrictions: Cannot infer ages or private retention from public profiles or comments
Cannot copy plots, dialogue, characters or unlicensed media
Cannot substitute company reputation or revenue for content appeal
Cannot treat public virality as verified demand in our target cohort

agents.name: Evidence Reviewer & Story Decoder
agents.trigger_proposed: New signal; editorially shortlisted property or supplied reference
allowed_actions_after_activation: Check period, scope, denominators and permissions
Compare like-for-like observations
Find contradictions and separate claims from interpretations
Check inspection coverage, cohort relevance and trend freshness separately from source credibility
Decode shortlisted stories with source/timecodes: character, relationships, payoff, continuation, fandom and Roblox fit
Record one primary cohort and evidence type D/O/I/FP
Keep shallow screening separate from full story decoding
outputs: Accepted-for-scope evidence record or unresolved/rejected claim
Research question with supporting and contrary evidence
Timestamped story-decoding packet and cohort scorecard with missing fields explicit
restrictions: Cannot verify a claim merely because another model agrees
Cannot upgrade evidence after retry exhaustion

agents.name: Audience Analyst
agents.trigger_proposed: After a fresh authorized analytics export or completed study
required_inputs: F10 authorized data and metric availability register
Preregistered creative hypothesis, primary cohort and exposure definition
allowed_actions_after_activation: Check freshness, missing data and sample size
Compare exposed cohorts and observation windows
Flag changes in completion, continuation and voluntary return
outputs: Dated performance brief
Anomalies with uncertainty and competing explanations
Deliberate episode-two choice, series return, completion and character-fandom findings where measurable
restrictions: Cannot access competitor private analytics
Cannot infer age from comments or make person-level youth profiles

agents.name: Development Assistant
agents.trigger_proposed: Only after an approved brief and production-development authorization
required_inputs: Editorially approved story/relationship thesis and decoding packet
One primary behavioral cohort and preregistered test objective
allowed_actions_after_activation: Draft premise or outline alternatives within the approved scope
Check motivation, continuity and script constraints
Prepare a writer review packet
outputs: Drafts marked unapproved
Continuity report and cited hypothesis links
restrictions: Cannot greenlight a story or change canon
Cannot claim simulated viewers validate resonance
Disabled while episode development is paused

agents.name: Production Planner
agents.trigger_proposed: After exact script version is approved
allowed_actions_after_activation: Extract scene and shot requirements
Retrieve licensed assets and identify missing dependencies
Propose timing, render route and bounded cost estimates
outputs: Versioned shot manifest
Asset/voice requests and preview plan
restrictions: Cannot silently change dialogue or approved character identity
Cannot dispatch paid production before preview and budget approval

agents.name: Production Coordinator
agents.trigger_proposed: When approved jobs become ready; on worker/provider events
allowed_actions_after_activation: Dispatch independent ready jobs within limits
Reconcile external task IDs and charges
Resume work and invalidate stale dependent outputs
outputs: Candidate takes with receipts and provenance
Blocked-job or budget exception records
restrictions: Use deterministic queue logic for permissions, retries and budgets
Cannot duplicate paid work on an ambiguous timeout
Cannot override spending caps or publish content

agents.name: Quality Assistant
agents.trigger_proposed: After a take, cut or master arrives
allowed_actions_after_activation: Run technical media checks
Flag likely identity, action, timing or continuity defects
Prepare timestamped repair requests and delivery checklist
outputs: Review packet with evidence and defect reasons
Technical pass/fail distinct from creative approval
restrictions: Cannot approve emotional quality, rights or release alone
Cannot treat a model score as audience demand

agents.name: Learning Planner
agents.trigger_proposed: Daily triage; weekly creative shortlist; completed experiment window
required_inputs: Reviewed content mechanism cards and daily culture signals
Approved objectives and competitive content comparisons
allowed_actions_after_activation: Synthesize separate viral, story/IP and execution assessments with confidence, sample size and rights status
Prepare at most five new daily findings and at most three weekly creative opportunities
Compare first-party outcomes with preregistered hypotheses and matched baselines where possible
Recommend WATCH, INVESTIGATE, TEST, DEVELOP_PILOT or RIGHTS_REVIEW for human decision
outputs: Daily intelligence brief (maximum five new findings; no-change valid)
Weekly creative shortlist (maximum three opportunities)
Separate scorecards, test proposal and human decision packet
restrictions: Cannot auto-change audience strategy, model prompts or spending
Cannot silently train on raw viewer data or auto-publish
A virality-potential score is an uncalibrated editorial assessment, never a probability or observed audience result
Cannot combine three scores into a master rank or require high virality for a high-story opportunity
Cannot initiate rights outreach or development without explicit authorization

creative_gate.missing_component_policy: NULL_WITH_REASON; affected score incomplete; do not reweight or rank as complete
additional_requirements: Primary cohort, character/relationship engine and goals specified
Originality, rights, age safety, budget and feasibility reviewed
Development explicitly authorized; experiment preregistered before release

routing.high_viral_low_story: Consider original marketing/meme test, not an automatic pilot
routing.high_story_moderate_viral: Consider original pilot development with editorial approval
routing.all_three_high: Prioritize editorial development or rights review; no automatic commitment

cadence_and_caps.capacity_resolution: Implementation default: 3–5 candidate screens; up to 3 full decodes total, with MDL/WEBTOON sharing this cap. Source wording overlaps; do not treat per-feed caps as additive.
cadence_and_caps.timing_note: Targets after prerequisites and explicit authorization, not promised service levels; paused production cannot dispatch
